instruction: I keep a log of all my liked songs and respective artists in a note in simple_note. I want to add release month information for them as well. I have added it for the first few songs. Add it for the rest.
notes: Two apps: simple_note (find and read the song log, then rewrite only its content) and spotify (liked songs with release dates). The note is located via search_notes and read via show_note; release dates come from show_liked_songs (paginate with page_index if the liked list exceeds one page; if release_date is absent, call spotify.show_song per remaining song). update_note passes only note_id/access_token/content so no other note field changes, and exactly one note is updated. complete_task carries no answer because the task is not a question; it is forced last via (not (task-completed)) on all actions and the goal condition (note-updated ...) as its precondition.
